changes.initial_review: Generic VGA byte/word write rotates by the low byte of the DWORD rotate field. Offset1407 selects the high byte on this little-endian carrier;1404 selects the value written by the original setter.
changes.counter_review: Actual consumers perform byte loads and 8-bit rotation, including both bytes of a word. Existing actual-provider fixture selects generic assign mode and checks independent expected plane bytes for rotations1..7; simply reverting would lose rotation. Do not infer real guest reachability from fixture selection.
changes.limits: Source/fixture audit only; historical runs are not new results and real guest hit remains unproved.
changes.change_plan: Keep three field-base constants and original rotate implementation. No helper, duplicated rotate state or altered generated control flow needed.
changes.related_callers: setVideorotate/getVideorotate and selected generic byte/word VGA write providers through c_ev_write_ptr.
changes.verification_required: Actual-provider generic BYTE and WORD plane oracle at rotate1..7, rotate0 control, selected build and graphics regressions for future changes.
changes.missing_evidence: No fresh execution; fixture does not establish an actual guest hit of these generic rotation cases.
